detail: Rome had already taken Sicily from Carthage in the First Punic War (264–241 BCE). In the second, Hannibal marches over the Alps and in 216 BCE destroys a Roman army at Cannae, one of the worst defeats in its history.
label: 218–216 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Hannibal crushes Rome at Cannae
tldr: Hannibal crosses the Alps and wipes out a Roman army, but Rome fights on and beats him at Zama in 202.
